legacy_source_metadata.finding: These are legacy top-level dispatch fields, not dashboard source_ref.head_sha. The dashboard normalizes source_ref to an empty object and therefore does not present the old head as the delivery binding. The current task title and next action explicitly identify PR #4282, its exact head, and its merge commit.

acceptance.statement: Governed show and generated current-work/dashboard agree on task existence.
A divergent file-only or ghost task cannot override the authoritative journal, and a stale projection cannot regenerate derived views.
A stale structured source_ref.head_sha is explicitly flagged against later exact-head evidence; a merged delivery left non-terminal is explicitly flagged for closeout.
acceptance.note: The live task row still carries older top-level source_pr/source_head fields rather than structured source_ref. The dashboard does not expose those fields as source_ref; exact PR #4282 delivery identity is explicit in the task title/next and this manifest. No claim is made that PR #4282 migrated legacy source fields.

acceptance.statement: A journal-backed bridge assignment survives the next authoritative projection refresh.
The already-merged implementation is closed out without restarting or broadening implementation.
